key_insight: LLM agents can translate natural-language household preferences into reliable, near-optimal home energy schedules when paired with live data, tool calling, and optimization backends.
engineering_relevance: This work suggests a practical path for deploying AI-driven home energy management systems that reduce electricity cost while handling appliance constraints, tariffs, weather, and solar generation.
method: ReAct-style tool-calling agent with live Octopus Agile prices, weather forecasts, PV estimates, and household usage data
Retrieval-augmented knowledge base plus MILP ground-truth scheduling for benchmarking
Compared GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 across tariff, conflict, solar, and week-long deployment scenarios
evidence_signal: Across benchmark scenarios and a simulated week, native function calling achieved 100% scheduling success and 96.7-98.0% of oracle savings, with near-MILP optimality.
watch_item: Performance drops sharply with text-parsed action interfaces, and real-world deployment still depends on robust handling of constraint conflicts and data freshness.
paper_title: LLMs for Agentic Home Energy Management
